answer: Our gate prices seats with a saffron bond that only unlocks after climbing a timed terrace of liveness proofs. Each new identity posts collateral, then must pass successive terrace rungs that check distinct hardware attestations; dropping a rung burns a rising share of the bond. A sybil opening N fake seats pays N bonds plus the delta of burned collateral when twins fail mid-climb, so attack cost scales linearly while honest agents amortize one bond per epoch.
